description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldName, which extends SugarWidgetFieldVarchar. The class provides methods for displaying, selecting, and filtering name-related fields in report layouts within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes logic for handling hyperlinks, inline editing, and concatenation of name fields, tailored for reporting purposes in the CRM system.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldName
classes.description: A widget class for rendering and filtering name fields in reports, offering hyperlink display, inline editing, and concatenation functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with layout manager and sets up reporter and id widget.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates an HTML link for a list display of a name field, with optional inline editing features.

methods.name: _get_normal_column_select
methods.description: Returns the SQL select statement for a simple concatenation of name fields.

methods.name: _get_column_select
methods.description: Constructs the SQL expression to concatenate name parts according to locale formatting.

methods.name: queryFilterIs
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for matching a specific record ID, considering current user context.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not
methods.description: Creates a filter condition for excluding a specific record ID, considering current user context.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Builds an 'IN' filter condition for multiple values, including current user substitution.

methods.name: queryFilternot_one_of
methods.description: Builds a 'NOT IN' filter condition for multiple values, including current user substitution.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Provides the SQL GROUP BY clause for name fields, with special handling for 'full_name'.
